title: Minimally Invasive Sacroiliac (SI) Joint Fusion
jurisdiction: CMS Hospital Outpatient Prior Authorization (42 CFR § 419.80)
description: CMS prior authorization for minimally invasive sacroiliac joint fusion. Requires chronic low back/buttock pain >= 6 months, >= 3 positive physical exam provocation tests, failure of >= 6 months conservative management, and >= 75% pain relief from fluoroscopically guided diagnostic SI joint injection.

criteria.name: Diagnostic SI Block Pain Relief (>= 75%)
criteria.description: Documented >= 75% relief of pain immediately following fluoroscopically or CT-guided local anesthetic injection into the SI joint.
criteria.clinical_intent: Validate SI joint as primary pain generator
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide

criteria.name: Positive SI Joint Provocation Tests (>= 3 Tests)
criteria.description: Physical examination documenting positive response on >= 3 provocative SI joint maneuvers (e.g. FABER/Patrick, Gaenslen, distraction, thigh thrust, compression).
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm clinical exam signs of sacroiliac dysfunction
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide

criteria.name: Active Systemic Infection Exclusion
criteria.description: Active localized or systemic infection, osteomyelitis of pelvis, or untreated inflammatory sacroiliitis (ankylosing spondylitis).
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude infectious or active rheumatologic spondyloarthropathy
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide
